name: biomolecular-structure-viewer
description: Interactive 3D biomolecular structure viewer via Mol*. Renders 3D molecular structures from local workspace files (.cif, .mmcif, .pdb) or conversation artifacts, and manages user 3D annotations and highlighted residues. Use when the user asks to visualise a protein or nucleic acid, display a 3D structure, or asks about 3D biomolecular structure annotations and highlighted residues.
